Moving to the ocean's heat

[Verse 2]

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
Summer waves, take me high
Dancing under open sky
Summer waves, feel the beat

[Chorus]
Summer waves, take me high
Dancing under open sky
Summer waves, feel the beat
Moving to the ocean's heat

[Outro]
Ocean's heat, fading out
Summer waves, hear me shout
Fading out, into the blue
